learning_outcomes.text: Our country is prone to disasters. Therefore, we must recognize the dangers and disasters that await us. Thus, we can achieve good disaster management. The content of this course aims to understand how the Earth and atmosphere system works and to learn the formation, development, types, characteristics, effects, consequences, history, regional and global distribution of disasters developing within this system.

syllabus_topics: General Characteristics of the Earth: Solar system, formation of the Earth, location, climates, seasons, Milankovitch hypothesis, internal characteristics of the Earth
General Characteristics of the Earth's Crust: Formation, types, geochemistry, continental movements and plate tectonics, orogeny, etc.
General Characteristics of the Atmosphere: Formation, chemistry, layers, thicknesses, temperature, pressure characteristics
Wind Systems, Oceans, Seas, Currents and Waves: Biological, physical and chemical properties of oceans, global winds and currents, waves and their characteristics
Classification of Disasters: Types based on origin
Earthquakes: Formation, types, characteristics, regions, seismicity of the World and Turkey
Tsunami: Formation, characteristics, history, protection methods and planning
Volcanoes: Formation mechanism, types, characteristics, history, global distribution, effects, benefits, harms
Mass Movements (Landslides, flows, falls, collapses, slips, etc.): Classification, formation, characteristics
Floods and Inundations: General characteristics of precipitation, river systems, development, characteristics, causes, consequences
Hurricanes (Typhoons, Cyclones), Tornadoes and Storm Surges: Formation, characteristics, effects, global distribution
Rip Currents: Wave characteristics and rip current development, causes of drowning, protection and avoidance

Global Climate Change: What is climate change? Cooling and warming, geological climate history, consequences of climate change, natural effects, human effects, connection between civilizations and climates
Radon Gas and Humans: Source, characteristics, effects, radon in structures, adverse effects on human health, natural materials emitting radon, protection measures
